name: AI Ops Triage Automation Demo
purpose: Convert inbound requests into a prioritized action queue with draft follow-ups for human review.

trigger.source: CSV export, Google Sheet, CRM export, or webhook payload

steps.description: Read source rows, trim text, coerce numeric fields, and validate required columns.
Flag requests that involve academic cheating, sensitive regulated data, spam, or risky automated outreach.
Score each request by urgency, estimated value, age, fit keywords, and safety status.
Assign priority labels and recommended next actions.
Prepare short follow-up drafts for human review. Do not send automatically.
Write triaged CSV, action plan Markdown, draft replies, and JSON summary.

human_approval_gate: All external replies remain drafts until the account owner approves and sends them.
production_notes: Use sample or redacted data for the first milestone.
Do not store production credentials in chat or source files.
For healthcare, finance, legal, hiring, housing, or education workflows, confirm policy and compliance constraints before adding AI steps.
For n8n or Make deployment, keep idempotency keys and logging visible.
